note: 082: the strategies a seat commits to at its round-1 keep, from its board and opening 10 (crates/aic-sim/src/agents/strategy.rs). A strategy is a weight vector over a card's tags, the resources and tokens it pays in or out, its kind and its categories; a card's multiplier is 1 plus the weights it matches, times the phase schedule's for its categories. `says` is the strategy in a player's words (docs/agents.md prints them). Agent numbers, not rules.

strategies.name: Industry income
strategies.says: Play Industry income early (Payroll Automation, Robotic Foundry), and stack Industry tags toward Arcology Foundry and Vertical Monopoly; spend two spent Industry cards on Rush Build.

strategies.name: Power grid
strategies.says: Take Power cards and energy income (Baseload Contract, Substation Hub), climb the Power tags to Dyson Swarm and the Supergrid, and cash spent Power cards with Overcharge; Power to the People frees a city at the end.

strategies.name: Capital finance
strategies.says: Build Capital piles (Retained Earnings, Expansion Fund, Sovereign Capital Fund), cash them when they are big, and save the credits for Hostile Buyout.

strategies.name: Wide build
strategies.says: Fill your five slots with Action buildings and use one each round, and push the card-play track to Master Plan's discount.

strategies.name: Troop wall
strategies.says: Stand your nodes in the troops' way, take the troop removals (Interceptor Battery, Kill Team Roster) and finish with Total Containment or Kinetic Interdiction.

strategies.name: Counter desk
strategies.says: Answer threats with the typed jams and counters, build Sentinel Command and Security Contractor HQ, and send Peacekeeping Mission to a corrupted city.

strategies.name: Diplomacy and liberation
strategies.says: Take Diplomacy and Followers (Liaison Corps, Open Assembly, Accord's node), and free cities with Great Liberation and Popular Uprising.

strategies.name: Civic shelter
strategies.says: Keep what you have standing: Bulwark, Hardened Bunker Complex, Safehouse Network and the Shelter power, toward Aegis Doctrine.

strategies.name: Cubes and stations
strategies.says: Build stations early (Field Station), Grant cubes onto megaprojects, Peer Review your nodes, and spend the cubes on Forensic Audit.

strategies.name: Science chain
strategies.says: Stack Science tags: Quantum Decryptor and Citation Engine first, then Breakthrough Lab and Foundation Model Campus.

strategies.name: Patience burst
strategies.says: Save your insight under Patience and spend it in a big round on draws (Fieldwork, Simulation Cluster, Orbital Observatory Array).

strategies.name: Datasets
strategies.says: Grow Dataset piles (Telemetry Archive, Synthetic Data Forge) toward Exabyte Archive, and cash them for insight and cards.

strategies.name: Team support
strategies.says: Feed your partner: gifts, Open Science's insight, Policy Institute's Sway, Audit against projects, and Root Access for a corrupted city.
